capability: Native scoped recording consent and completed transcript metadata linkage only; AI review remains blocked.
advisor_assessment: All advisor counts unchanged. No new table/index or existing policy/grant changes.
limits: Native activated mapped identity must be an active organization member and recording owner or same-org admin; manager delegation remains pending.
Consent is required before transcript metadata checking. Status can report consent=false; default review returns HTTP 409 consent_required.

Explicit transcript pointers must match tenant, recording and completed status. Fallback only when no pointer is supplied selects newest completed same-org same-recording metadata. No content read; linkage does not assert nonempty or trustworthy content.
Default review is blocked with completed_transcript_required or recording_review_verification_required; no provider call, transcript/audio text read, score, review insert or recording marker change.

Execution requires transcript provenance/version/privacy, provider/tier/cost verification, complete finite competency scores with transcript-grounded evidence and atomic idempotent finalization with renewed consent verification.
No customer-data copy, hosted cutover, main merge, schedule, final source delta or source retirement.
